verdict.rationale: Postmark documents broad API coverage beyond sending. That includes templates (create, edit, validate, push to another server), bounces, message search and inbound retry/bypass, stats, webhooks, inbound configuration, and sender signatures. Account-level resources are also covered: servers CRUD, message streams, and domain DKIM/SPF/Return-Path verification plus DKIM rotation. Together this suggests most UI actions are scriptable. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for add-ons and settings (data retention, DMARC monitoring, dedicated IP management, billing), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
